program.rationale: Estimate surviving compatible value through an internal edge penalty, floored by the heaviest compatible residual node.

program.name: edge_corrected_budget
program.rationale: Combine three neighborhood budget estimates and add normalized weighted and unweighted measures of conflict redundancy.

program.name: interval_counterfactual

program.name: rel01_neighbor_clique_ratio
program.rationale: Treat mutually conflicting neighbors as shared alternatives, using a clique partition upper estimate of displaced independent weight.

program.name: rel02_neighbor_packing_ratio
program.rationale: Compare root weight with a constructive packing of its blocked alternatives, distinguishing independent neighbors from mutually exclusive ones.

program.name: rel03_include_packing_value
program.rationale: Score inclusion by root weight plus a feasible residual packing estimate, with a small degree regularizer.

program.name: rel04_cover_marginal_ratio
program.rationale: Estimate displaced opportunity from the difference between exclusion and inclusion residual covers, guarded by the heaviest direct conflict.

program.name: rel05_min_endpoint_redundancy
program.rule: weight / max(0.000000001, weight + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight - 2 * neighbor_edge_min / max(1, degree)))
program.rationale: Discount blocked weight using the cheaper endpoints of conflicts among alternatives. Normalize repeated edge contributions by neighborhood size and retain the heaviest blocked alternative as a floor.

program.name: rel06_weighted_pair_exclusion
program.rule: weight / max(0.000000001, weight + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight - 2 * neighbor_edge_product / max(0.000000001, conflict_weight)))
program.rationale: Estimate blocked opportunity from compatible mass around a weight-proportional alternative. Conflicts between heavy alternatives receive stronger redundancy discounts, while the heaviest alternative remains fully represented.

program.name: rel07_edge_density_anchor
program.rule: weight / max(0.000000001, weight + max_conflict_weight + max(0, conflict_weight - max_conflict_weight) / max(1, 1 + 2 * neighbor_edge_count / max(1, degree)))
program.rationale: Preserve the dominant blocked alternative and discount the remaining blocked weight according to internal edge density. Additional alternatives may contribute less opportunity when they conflict heavily with one another.

program.name: rel08_saturated_collision_margin
program.rule: weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / max(1, 1 + 2 * neighbor_edge_product / max(0.000000001, conflict_weight * conflict_weight)))
program.rationale: Rank absolute gain against discounted blocked mass. Weighted collision density supplies a saturating redundancy discount, retaining substantial opportunity cost even for densely conflicting alternatives.

program.name: rel09_branch_midpoint
program.rationale: Compare midpoint estimates of the inclusion and exclusion branches, using greedy packing and clique cover as lower and upper estimates and normalizing by their objective scale.

program.name: rel10_branch_uncertainty_penalty
program.rationale: Penalize the greedy branch advantage by both cover-versus-packing gaps, favoring inclusion decisions whose residual opportunity estimates have less uncertainty.

program.name: rel11_density_interpolated_loss
program.rationale: Use neighborhood edge density to continuously interpolate displaced opportunity between greedy packing and clique cover, with denser neighborhoods placing more weight on packing.

program.name: rel12_density_modulated_branch_gain
program.rationale: Modulate the normalized greedy branch advantage by the change in weighted residual conflict density, incorporating residual structure beyond retained packing weight.

program.name: weighted_closed_density
